title: PortableCompressedTexture2D.create_from_image() fails with VRAM compressed formats
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproduced in: 4.4.1-stable, 4.3-stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono (49a5bc7b6) - cpe:/o:nixos:nixos:25.11 #1-NixOS ZEN SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue Jan  1 00:00:00 UTC 1980 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6800 (RADV NAVI21) - AMD Ryzen 5 7600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

`PortableCompressedTexture2D.create_from_image()` fails with all VRAM compressed formats (ASTC, BPTC, etc.). When using lossy or lossless formats, it works as expected. Additionally, on my C# project, it also crashes the editor with a segmentation fault when create_from_image is called in a tool script (though it might have the same behavior when running in debug mode, I didn't test that).

Relevant logs:
```
ERROR: Expected Image data size of 1000x1000x4 (RGBA8 without mipmaps) = 4000000 bytes, got 1000000 bytes instead.
   at: initialize_data (core/io/image.cpp:2201)
ERROR: Width must be equal or greater than 1 for all textures
   at: texture_create (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:682)
ERROR: Condition "texture.rd_texture.is_null()" is true.
   at: texture_2d_initialize (servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp:841)
ERROR: Attempting to use an uninitialized RID
   at: get_or_null (./core/templates/rid_owner.h:199)
ERROR: Parameter "tex" is null.
   at: texture_set_size_override (servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp:1407)
ERROR: Attempting to use an uninitialized RID
   at: get_or_null (./core/templates/rid_owner.h:199)
ERROR: Parameter "t" is null.
   at: texture_free (servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp:767)
```

### Steps to reproduce

- Call `create_from_image` on a new `PortableCompressedTexture2D` with a VRAM compressed format
Or if using the MRP:
- Launch the game
